title: equals without hashCode
summary: A User that forgot hashCode lands twice in the same HashSet.

turns.user: added two Users with the same id to a HashSet and size() says 2. bug?

assistant.body: Great question! Not a bug. The class has equals but no hashCode, so the set drops the two into different buckets. Override one, you owe the other: that is the contract.

turns.user: bet it's not the only one. can you find the classes with equals and no hashCode?

assistant.body: Certainly. List the files that implement equals, then keep only the ones with no hashCode in them.
grep -rl "public boolean equals" src/main/java | xargs grep -L "public int hashCode"
